title: Christopher Bengtsson — Software developer & consultant
description: Senior software engineer based in Sweden. Available remotely for smaller projects: features, fixes, integrations, automation and code reviews.
availability: Available for smaller, clearly scoped projects
headline: I build software, automate tasks and improve existing systems.
introduction: I'm Christopher, a full-stack developer with over nine years of experience building interfaces, backend services, databases, cloud solutions and integrations. I take time to understand your business goals and build solutions with future development and maintenance in mind.
supportingLine: Available remotely for smaller projects: automate one workflow, connect two systems, or improve a defined part of your application.

services.title: What I do
services.intro: I help with new features, existing applications, integrations, automation and technical reviews. I am currently available for smaller assignments with a clear scope and an agreed handover.

capabilities.title: Build and extend
capabilities.description: I build features, internal tools and integrations, connecting interfaces, backend services and data into a working whole.
details: A new feature often needs changes across the interface, backend services and data. I can take responsibility for that work within an established team's architecture and development practices, or help a growing startup add the features and integrations its next stage requires. I work with the people who know the product to understand what needs to change and how it fits together.

If you're starting with an idea or a first app built with AI, I can help define a manageable first version and build the missing pieces. The aim is working software that serves your business, with code and practical handover notes that you or your team can continue to develop.

capabilities.title: Improve and maintain
capabilities.description: I fix problems in existing apps and systems, add useful tests and set up a review process for dependency updates.
details: When an app feels fragile or routine changes become difficult, I fix the underlying problems and add tests around important user flows. That can mean preparing a first AI-built app for launch, keeping a growing startup's codebase manageable or updating an established system while preserving the behavior other teams depend on.

Depending on the project, I can improve performance, check access controls and address how API keys and other credentials are handled. I can also set up Dependabot to propose dependency updates, then review and test those changes before they are applied. The result is a clearer maintenance routine and a codebase that is easier to change.

capabilities.title: Automate a manual workflow
capabilities.description: Reduce repeated data entry or manual handovers. We agree one workflow, the rules it follows, and how exceptions should be handled. I assess where AI could help.
details: Copying information between tools, following up requests and passing work between teams can leave a process dependent on repeated manual steps. I help operations and product teams identify one workflow to improve, including where information enters, which rules apply and where a person needs to make a decision.

We agree the inputs, the expected result and how to handle exceptions before implementation. The work can include an integration, a notification or an approval step, depending on the systems involved. You receive the agreed changes, checks and practical handover notes. If feasibility is unclear, we can start with a separately agreed investigation.

capabilities.title: Review and advise
capabilities.description: I review code, architecture and technical plans, then give you prioritized findings and clear next steps.
details: Before committing to a launch, an integration or a larger technical change, it helps to understand the risks and options. I can review an established team's proposed architecture against the systems already in place, or help a startup weigh technical improvements against its product roadmap. The review focuses on the decisions you need to make.

For a first app built with AI, I can explain what needs attention before real users start relying on it, even if you don't have a technical background. You receive findings in plain language: what I would address now, what can wait and why. That gives you or your team a practical basis for planning the work.

experience.title: Selected work
experience.intro: A few projects from employment and consulting assignments, spanning architecture, implementation and long-term ownership.
experience.note: Mentioning these organizations does not imply that they endorse my independent services.

jobs.description: I work in an international team on Evinova's clinical trial platform for patients, study sites and sponsors. My work spans React apps and Hapi/NestJS services that connect to other teams' Spring Boot backends or send email notifications through Kafka events or job queues. I also troubleshoot issues with QA colleagues and have worked on a backward-compatible login flow and tests in Playwright and Cucumber.

At Trustly, I co-built a customer verification (KYC) workflow with another full-stack developer. React forms submitted data to an Express service for validation and storage in Postgres through Prisma, before passing it to Salesforce. My work covered validation, data storage and integration between the systems.

My team was responsible for Trustly's microfrontend architecture, developer tooling and UI library. I helped build the Azura checkout and reworked the PayPal top-up site's interface and user experience. I worked mainly in React, alongside Spring Boot and Postgres, with real-time data and Playwright tests that included accessibility checks.

jobs.company: Headlight / Relight · consulting for the Swedish Transport Administration
jobs.description: Through Headlight/Relight, I built and maintained a change-request portal for Trafikverket, the Swedish Transport Administration, as its sole developer. The work primarily used K2’s process engine and SmartForms, alongside SQL Server stored procedures and a SOAP/XML connection to another system. I stayed in regular contact with business stakeholders.

privacy.title: Privacy information
privacy.controller: Christopher Bengtsson is responsible for personal data sent through this site. You can contact me at the email address below.
privacy.purpose: When you send an inquiry, I use your name, email address and message to read it, respond and discuss a possible project. Please do not include sensitive personal information in the message.
privacy.basis: I rely on my legitimate interest in responding to relevant inquiries and considering potential work. You can object to this processing at any time.
privacy.providers: Cloudflare hosts the site and handles the form and email forwarding. Resend sends the inquiry email, and Microsoft handles my destination mailbox. These providers process the data needed to deliver the message. Their services may process data outside the EU/EEA under their applicable data-transfer safeguards.
privacy.analytics: I use Cloudflare Web Analytics to understand visits and page performance, and Cloudflare Analytics Engine to measure section views, capability expansions, contact and profile clicks, form starts and successful submission requests on published home and service pages. Custom events contain only predefined event labels, language, page path and site hostname, with a timestamp. They do not contain form contents, IP addresses, user-agent strings or query strings, and this tracking does not set cookies or persistent visitor identifiers. Cloudflare processes the events, which are retained for three months; Web Analytics reports are available for six months. These aggregate measurements help me improve the site and do not identify individual visitor journeys. The page path identifies where a contact action or submission was recorded, not how the visitor arrived there.
privacy.retention: I delete unanswered inquiries after 12 months. If we begin working together, I may keep relevant correspondence for the relationship and any applicable legal obligations.
